summary: Biodexa Pharmaceuticals PLC furnished a Form 6-K on September 11, 2026, attaching a press release reporting unaudited interim financial and operating results for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing also incorporates the interim statements by reference into existing Form S-8 and Form F-3 registration statements. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural deal terms were disclosed. This is a routine periodic earnings filing by a foreign private issuer, with no special-situation event; the risk-arb angle is absent, and the operational focus remains pipeline and cash runway.
